top_signals.title: Equinor Profits Triple as Oil and Gas Prices Surge
top_signals.summary: Equinor tripled its adjusted net income for the third quarter from a year earlier, on the back of strong refining margins, high oil and natural gas prices, and increased hydrocarbon production.   The Norwegian energy major on Wednesday reported an adjusted net income of $2.86 billion for the third quarter, tripled from the $932 million income for the same period last year. top_signals.title: Stellantis reports $4.5 billion cash drain as massive turnaround plan continues
top_signals.summary: European car giant Stellantis said Wednesday that it recorded a 4 billion euro ($4.5 billion) cash shortfall in the third quarter.
